Title: Citrus ransomware - ipv4
Description: Citrus-controlled server (BlueVPS, Estonia). It was named in the cdc attribute of Certighost (CVE-2026-54121) certificate requests so the CA fetched forged data from it, and it received data stolen by the Citrus keylogger. Source: Kaspersky Securelist – Citrus ransomware: VLESS for traffic, Sn00py for encryption, and LLMs lending a hand https://securelist.com/citrus-ransomware/121879/
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.
